ORDINANCE

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1, The Chicago Zoning Ordinance is amended by changing all of the C1-1,
Neighborhood Commercial District symbols and indications as shown on Map No. 28-H
in the area bound by:

South Davol Street; a line 121 feet north of the intersection of South Davol Street and
West 115" Street as measured along the east right-of-way line of South Davol Street
and perpendicular thereto; Chicago, Rock Island and Pacific Railroad; and West 115"
Street,

to those of a B2-2, Neighborhood Mixed-Use District.
SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be effective after its passage and publication.

Lae fade
